policy: No permanent agent without Capability Gap + A/B Eval.

latestDecision.capabilityGap: JOB-009 has repeated bounded technical evidence but lacks defensible elapsed-human-time and cross-project generality evidence for stable skill promotion.
latestDecision.reason: This is an evidence/measurement gap, not an Agent capability gap. JOB-009 CI, AETHER review and SENTINEL bounded QA pass; the remaining uncertainty is measurable time compression and broader generality.
latestDecision.route: NO_AGENT_NEEDED. Keep the existing Core route MAKER -> AETHER -> SENTINEL -> MENTOR; run a materially different bounded retest with precise start/end human-time, defect/rework/reuse evidence and browser smoke before any stable skill promotion.
